entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown with short gray hair around the sides/back and gray eyebrows remains. The face has one restrained closed mouth, a smooth chin and no moustache, beard, headgear or glasses. The nearly frontal head turns subtly toward viewer left, with a slightly left gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop, soft warm frontal light and moderate cheek shadows. The dark olive uniform retains two red-and-gold collar patches, a gold viewer-left shoulder board, one red-and-white neck ribbon and one silver-toned cross-shaped pendant. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with two compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact collar and neck-pendant symbols cannot be transcribed, and note glyphs are indistinct; visible red-white and silver-toned forms, counts and two-row upper-note footprint were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
